关于教室的故事(A Story about the classroom): 一篇关于校园生活的A2短文:格蕾丝与欧文的经历和小计划。
Last Saturday, Grace and Owen went to the classroom. Grace hopes to visit Sydney one day. Grace is going to travel to Sydney in March. The soup needs a tad more salt, I think.
Grace is reading a book about music. Both of them like bread and juice. It takes twenty minutes to get to the classroom by bike. In biology we learned about cells.
Grace wrote about the day in the diary. Grace usually has bread for breakfast. Grace thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. The staff meeting kept to fifteen minutes.
Grace learned a lot about music. The weather was rainy that day. They took many photos at the school garden.
